sources.capture_context: Camera point/heading from the supplied Maps URL: 40.4350711,-86.9250796, yaw 98.54251 degrees. It looks across the parking apron toward FID 761; camera is approximately 62.77 m from transformed GIS centroid, centroid bearing differs from heading by 7.93 degrees, and nearest footprint edge is 42.53 m away.
sources.use: Visual support for only the camera-facing facade: red-brown brick, two visible window bands, tall central glazed entry bay and shallow light canopy. Roof mostly obscured; height is an estimate; unseen elevations and interior are not inferred.
sources.limitations: Alignment uses project approximate campus-local transform and URL camera coordinates, not survey control or an independent panorama metadata API. No dimensions or exact facade spacing are measured.

facade_evidence.status: one camera-facing facade visually supported; other elevations unverified
facade_evidence.notes: Google Maps Street View pano ytu8Bz_eEp2xCv9QeF0xRw (April 2026 date shown in listing) looks across the apron toward FID 761. The target alignment is plausible by approximate camera-to-FID bearing/distance calculation. Visible cues: red-brown brick, two bands of windows, central vertical glazed entry bay and shallow canopy. Trees obscure most of the roof. The two visible bands conflict with GIS NUM_LEVELS=1; model height is estimated, not measured. No floor plan or upper interior source was found.

coordinate_method.project_transform: Inverse Web Mercator to longitude/latitude, then project repository approximate local conversion: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0

coordinate_method.uncertainty: Approximate local conversion, not survey control.
